subject: Finora audit: orchestration artifacts & rehearsal outputs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@finora.com>

Cc: compliance@finora.com
Date: 2026-09-10T16:03:00-04:00
Subject: Finora audit: orchestration artifacts & rehearsal outputs

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off the documentation review for our upcoming SIG/CAIQ audit. We need a concise package that shows how Redwood's orchestration and failover behavior support our RTO/RPO commitments. Specifically Finora is asking for:

- A current copy of the DR runbook used during automated failover (snapshot with timestamps)
- Rehearsal/tabletop logs from the most recent exercise (prefer CSV export)
- Measured RTO/RPO observed in the last two rehearsals and the methodology used to capture them
- KV-cache warm/prepopulate timing and any pre-warm scripts or cron jobs
- A simple orchestration failover matrix showing decision points, fallbacks, and model variants used during degraded capacity

Can you send a single package (PDF + CSV/XLS) by EOD Friday so our audit team can ingest it? If anything requires an attestation or signature we'll flag it after review.

Thanks — appreciate a pointer to the specific files so we can reference them in the questionnaire.

—Liam O'Connor
Finora Payments — Senior Compliance Manager
liam@finora.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@finora.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Finora audit: orchestration artifacts & rehearsal outputs

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list.

We're assembling the package now. Attached to this message (and linked below) you'll find the initial artifacts: runbook snapshot, rehearsal CSV export, KV warm timings spreadsheet, and the orchestration matrix. High-level notes up front:

- Runbook snapshot: canonical PDF export with the version stamp and last edit (runbook_snapshot_20260910.pdf). It includes the play-by-play steps we run for region failover and the checklist operators follow.
- Tabletop/rehearsal: tabletop_rehearsal_log_20260909.csv contains timestamps, actor, scenario, and outcome flags.
- RTO/RPO figures: captured in the rehearsal CSV and summarized in the runbook appendix. Short answer: measured RTO for full service failover (primary -> secondary) was ~6m30s in the last simulated event; RPO is effectively zero for transactional state because we replicate commit logs across zones with <1s lag for persistent writes.
- KV cache warm: kv-cache-warm-timings_20260909.xlsx shows cold-start vs pre-warmed timings. Typical warm window (with prepopulation) is 15–22s depending on shard size; cold-start without pre-warm is 2–3 minutes. We note the scripts we use for pre-warm and the cron job schedule in the runbook.
- Orchestration matrix: orchestration_failover_matrix_v2.csv maps failure classes to primary actions, automatic vs manual thresholds, and fallback model variants (lightweight quantized variants used for immediate continuity).

I'm cc'ing Grace and Hannah for operational notes; Grace can add measured wall-clock logs and Hannah will attach the signed attestation template if you need it. Please confirm if you want raw system logs for the rehearsal (we can provide a sanitized export).

Attachments: runbook_snapshot_20260910.pdf (PDF), tabletop_rehearsal_log_20260909.csv (CSV), kv-cache-warm-timings_20260909.xlsx (XLSX), orchestration_failover_matrix_v2.csv (CSV)

Links: https://drive.google.com/finora/finora-bcp-pack

Thanks,
Jonas

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Finora audit: orchestration artifacts & rehearsal outputs

Hi Liam — adding the rehearsal artifacts and a few clarifying points on measurement so the audit team can reproduce the numbers if needed.

Rehearsal notes (excerpt):
- Scenario: Primary region AZ-out (simulated network partition, no data loss).
- Trigger: automated health-check cascade at t0. Orchestration initiated automatic failover at t0 + 12s after threshold breach.
- RTO (observed): 6m 30s from t0 to application-ready signal in the secondary region (includes DNS propagation bundle we manage via low-TTL records).
- RPO (observed): ~0–1s for persistent writes; replicate-on-commit via streaming replication with ack policy ensures durable commit before acknowledging to clients in most tiers.
- KV cache warm: prepopulation script (prewarm_kv_batch.sh) runs on failover start; we observed median first-lookup improvement from 180s cold to 18s with prewarm across the 32-shard test. Per-shard variance is in the spreadsheet.

Files attached in my response: tabletop_rehearsal_log_20260909.csv (CSV), kv-cache-warm-timings_20260909.xlsx (XLSX). I also pushed a sanitized log extract to the shared Drive folder the link above points to (redacted PII).

If Finora's auditors want, we can provide a short video screencap of the orchestration run (timestamps aligned) — that's helpful to cross-check.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Engineering Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Jonas / Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. The files look good at first pass. A couple of follow-ups before we close the ticket:

- Can you attach a short attestation (PDF) stating these artifacts are unmodified exports of your runbook and rehearsal logs, with a date and authorized signer? If you can include a Redwoods legal signatory we can accept that for evidentiary purposes.
- Please export the rehearsal CSV with a column for elapsed_seconds (we have an automated parser that expects it). If you can drop that into the same Drive folder by EOD Monday that would be ideal.
- We prefer a single zipped package for the final upload (runbook + CSV + XLSX + matrix + attestation).

If you want us to sign a mutual NDA addendum before we ingest logs, say the word and we can expedite. Otherwise we'll proceed with the documents you've provided.

Best,
Finora Compliance Team
